_meta.note: G7 Counter-Nanite facility, stealth strike dropship, dropship cargo bays, base secure state. Every number is PROVISIONAL (master scope 6.2, 6.9, 9; brainstorm B2, B4, B9, B11, B18).

cn_checkpoint.name: Armoured Gate Checkpoint
cn_checkpoint._note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-8): hardened pedestrian gatehouse in the wall line: two-door mantrap (team gates at _g7_facility.mantrap, owner only, sealed on lockdown), ID / scan station (mimics exposed), guard bunker with firing ports (garrisonable, remote weapon station). PROVISIONAL.

a_g7_camera.name: Security Camera
a_g7_camera._note: BASE7 (13.9b): a pan-tilt camera mast that watches its sector (real sight for the base, no weapon). PROVISIONAL.

a_g7_vtol_pad.name: Dropship Landing Pad
a_g7_vtol_pad._note: BASE7-2 (13.9c): 24 m landing site for the 19.6 x 16.7 m VTOL / stealth dropships (Last Protocol airfield). Flat: units walk and drive onto it (rear-ramp loading). Entity field facing_i = the side of its 3-tile approach lane (0 +x, 1 +y, 2 -x, 3 -y). Art: ART7F. PROVISIONAL.

cn_link_wall.name: Wash Link Wall
cn_link_wall._note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-9): 1-tile hardened T-wall run joining the outer gate layer to the inner gate layer on both sides of the APC wash (enclosed wash). Drawn as one g7_fac_linkwall zone sprite per run (entity_layer skips the cells). PROVISIONAL.

cn_magazine.name: Special Ammunition Magazine
cn_magazine._note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-6): the armoured cell of the earth-covered magazine (zone magazine, art g7_fac_magazine). The teams' special ammo resupply point (CnFacility services) and a priority target: destroyed, it cooks off (services.cookoff) and resupply stops. PROVISIONAL.

cn_ecp_baffle.name: Entry Blast Baffle
cn_ecp_baffle._note: FACB7-2 (owner 13.9c-8): 1-tile T-wall baffle of the blast-walled serpentine approach outside the foot entry control point (_g7_facility.baffles): the walk-in leg runs along the wall under the guard bunker's firing ports, so attackers cannot walk straight at the outer mantrap door. Art: g7_fac7f autotile. PROVISIONAL.

_g7_bay_seq._note: CNFAC7-2 C-17-style rear-ramp loading (scope 6.9, art.dropship_sizes rev4 geometry, tiles along the nose axis). PROVISIONAL timings.

_g7_facility._layout_note: BASE7-3 (13.9c-2/-3, PROVISIONAL): two-layer APC entry on the south wall: gate_outer (reinforced gate in the wall) -> apc_wash (APC decon wash between the layers) -> gate_inner -> staging yard; the infantry come in through the checkpoint (wall slot x18, a wall section x16 apart from the vehicle gate) up their own walkway (x17..20, y24..25) into the decon hall (x17..20, y21..23) and out north onto the y20 lane. Every building keeps its own footprint with >= 1 tile clearance to every other building (garages stand in two rows), doors open onto lanes, lanes never cross a footprint. Garage rows W/E on lanes x6..7 / x20..21; loading pad (stealth launch pad) + helipad on the north wall with the apron x15..18; planning room and package lab on the spine (x12..15); drone bay under the helipad apron; training range SW, workshop SE. Wall ring: 2x2 blast walls on even offsets, 16 hardened towers ON the wall line (13.9c-3 + 13.9c-4: 4 corners, 2-3 per long run, both entry flanks), closed and tied in on both sides; every tower keeps a free inner cell (wall-walk stairs, 13.9c-4) and no building lines a whole wall run. 13.9c-4 sentries: 1x1 a_t7_hmg_nest posts on the inner face of every wall run of >= 2 segments (they fire over the wall), facing outward, never on a tower's last free access cell, a door or a footprint. Core moved to [3,3] so the NW corner has its stair cell; range 8x4 / workshop 4x4 leave the south inner face open. 'gate' / 'decon' are code aliases of gate_outer / apc_wash (not drawn).
_g7_facility._facb75_note: FACB7-5 (owner 13.9c-18, PROVISIONAL): the drone bay is the SECOND STOREY of the workshop (stacked: same 4x4 footprint, one seamless building drawn by the workshop art: ground-floor APC workshop 6.5 m, drone-bay storey to 10.5 m, launch deck on its roof, stair core at the SE (back) corner with its ground door [20,12] on the east lane); the 3-storey hardened Sentinel barracks with its rooftop gunship pad moved to the drone bay's old site [16,14,4,2] (8 x 16 m, long face + blast-door vestibule south onto the y16 lane, door [17,16]); its old site [24,3,2,4] is open ground beside the helipad.
_g7_facility._fac6_note: FACB7 (owner 13.9c-6, PROVISIONAL): magazine = hardened earth-covered igloo (2x4 = 8x16 m) in the SE corner, farthest from the core / ops room, door north onto the y20 lane behind a traverse; its 2x2 armoured cell (magazine_part) is a real sim building (the priority target; cooks off when destroyed). armory = armory + suit bay on the infantry path (decon hall north door -> armory south door -> west door into the staging yard). aid_station (+ quarantine bay) is attached to the decon hall's east wall (one building, listed in 'attached'). barracks = the Sentinel barracks (owner 13.9c-10, was the 13.9c-6 ready room; trains / houses the facility guard company, backup generator on its roof slab) in the NE corner by the helipad. fuel_point = flush hot-refuel / rearm pits on the helipad apron (a marking on the apron lane, no footprint); the garages rearm too. runoff = contaminated-runoff tank beside the APC wash (equipment, no building). The workshop moved into the old drone-bay slot (APC repair on the spine), the drone bay shrank to 4x2 below it, the staging yard to 8x3, the helipad one tile west (ready room room). 13.9c-8: gate_inner turned to the outer gate's axis (faces); mantrap = the foot entry control point's two door cells (outer, inner) in the checkpoint gatehouse: team gates open only for the owner, both sealed on lockdown.
_g7_facility._facb76_note: FACB7-6 (owner 13.9c-20c, PROVISIONAL): the armory + suit bay is the SUIT FOUNDRY for the ~4 m amplified suits (radius 0.65 tiles, vehicle class, EXO7-2 fact cnsuits.radius). Zone [16,17,4,3] -> [16,17,4,4] (16 x 16 m, hall roof ~12 m): it grows south over the old y20 infantry lane x16..19 and is ATTACHED to the decon hall (shares its north wall: the infantry go decon hall -> foundry issue counter -> west door [15,18] into the staging yard, 13.9c-6). Suits never use the infantry path: the 2-tile bay doors [20,17] / [20,18] (8 m wide, 6.5 m tall) open east (face 0) onto the x20..21 vehicle lane (the APC lane to the east garages, y16 lane, spine, staging, inner gate, wash, outer gate); the test apron is the hall's open east bay in front of them; armory_part (EXO7-2's cn_armory 2x2) sits in the SW corner [16,19] so the bay floor x16..19 y17..18 stays clear for a suit; armory_exit = the lane point the suits roll out to (production rally). The decon hall's north door moved to [20,20] (its NE corner, on the x20 lane); the y20 lane is now [20,20,6,1]. Fuel bowser station (owner 13.9c-21b: 'besides the dropship helipad (expand that area as needed nothing crazy ...)', ORCH-approved plan): the helipad moved 1 tile east [18,2,6,6] -> [19,2,6,6] (still 6x6, inside the ring, 1 free column x25 by the NE towers), its apron lane [15,2,3,7] -> [16,3,3,6] and the hot-refuel pits fuel_point [15,3,3,4] -> [16,4,3,3] moved with it; fuel_bay [x, y, w, h, heading_deg] = Rect2(16.0, 2.05, 2.4, 0.9) at the head of the apron against the north wall inner face, nose east (0 deg) onto the helipad apron, in sight of the camera, outside the craft footprint and the APC line-up behind the ramp (APC body y >= 4.1); x15 y2..7 between the loading pad and the apron is open ground.
_g7_facility._mag_note: FACB7-3 (13.9c-6, in-game shots): the igloo is turned so its headwall + blast door face south (side 1, toward the camera) onto a 1-tile forecourt against the perimeter wall (the wall is its barricade: a cook-off vents outward, away from the compound); served by a service lane down x23 from the y20 lane.
_g7_facility._facb74_note: FACB7-4 (owner 13.9c-14, PROVISIONAL): planning = the 4-storey command centre (same 4x3 footprint, the facility's tallest, 16.9 m roof); barracks = the 3-storey hardened Sentinel barracks, grown 1 tile south ([24,3,2,3] -> [24,3,2,4], 8 x 16 m, still 1 tile clear of the garages; door [24,7]) so its roof carries a 7 x 15 m landing pad for the CN Vanta rotorless gunship (roof_pad: compound-local deck rect in tiles + deck height in metres; CnFacility.roof_pad / render_entries roof_pad; an owner aircraft landed on it is refuelled / rearmed like on the ground pads while the barracks stands); range = the training complex: a 2-storey fully indoor training building (CQB shoot-house floors, simulators) on the west half and the outdoor rifle / explosives testing range on the east half (same 8x4 zone, door north onto the y20 lane, a second gate at [8,20]); approach = a 5-tile cleared glacis outside the south wall (the gate apron + the foot-entry serpentine), paved with the compound in the same site clearing (FACB7-3 handoff: a map boulder stood on the gate apron).

roof_pad._note: FACB7-5 (13.9c-18): TLOF 15.0 x 7.0 m on the barracks roof at its new site (compound-local tiles), long axis along +x (heading 0 = nose east, +x); deck 11.6 m above ground; AIRV7 lands the gunship on rect centre at deck_z

_g7_facility._facb72_note: FACB7-2 (13.9c-8/-10/-11, PROVISIONAL): barracks_part = SENT7's cn_sentinel_barracks (2x2) on the barracks zone (zone art draws it); lockers = SENT7's cn_ammo_locker at the tower bases / wall-walk stairs (each tower keeps another free stair cell) and in the entry walkway corner beside the gatehouse; baffles = the serpentine approach outside the foot entry (compound-local, y >= compound): a walk-in leg along the wall from the west (x16..18, y28: (16,28) stays free, it is the front of a WTUR7 wall turret) closed by an L of T-wall baffles that ties into the gatehouse.
_g7_facility._armory_note: EXO7 (13.9c-20, PROVISIONAL): armory_part = EXO7's cn_armory (2x2) on the armory zone (FACB7-6: the Suit Foundry [16,17,4,4], part in its SW corner, bay doors [20,17] / [20,18] stay free); the only building that builds the CN armoured suits (defs_g7_cnsuits.json).
_g7_facility._baffle_note: FACB7-3 (owner 13.9c-8 'serpentine / blast-walled approach', PROVISIONAL): a real two-turn serpentine outside the foot entry (compound-local, y >= 28), boxed in by T-wall baffles: mouth at the west of the outer leg (x16..17, y30), outer leg east along y30 under the guard bunker's firing ports, a 180-degree turn at x22..23 (y29), inner leg back west along the wall (y28, under tower [20,26] and the wall turret at (23,27)), then north into the outer mantrap door (18,27). (17,28) closes the inner leg's west end, (24,28..31) its east end; (16,28) and (23,28) stay free (fronts of WTUR7 wall turrets). The APC gate mouth (x12..15) stays clear. ecp_start = a cell on the outer leg (tests).
